mapper.select: SELECT id FROM borrow_request WHERE status = 'approved' AND approve_time < #{approveTimeBefore} AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

SELECT r.id AS requestId, r.device_id AS deviceId, e.device_no AS deviceNo, e.name AS deviceName, e.status AS deviceStatus, r.borrower_id AS borrowerId, u.name AS borrowerName, r.create_time AS createTime FROM borrow_request r JOIN equipment e ON e.id = r.device_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.borrower_id WHERE r.status = 'pending' ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT r.id AS requestId, r.device_id AS deviceId, e.device_no AS deviceNo, e.name AS deviceName, e.status AS deviceStatus, r.borrower_id AS borrowerId, u.name AS borrowerName, r.create_time AS createTime, r.due_time AS dueTime, r.borrow_time AS borrowTime FROM borrow_request r JOIN equipment e ON e.id = r.device_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.borrower_id WHERE r.status = 'received' ORDER BY r.id ASC
